_comment: Top-50 exercise slugs for Stable Diffusion batch generation. Order = priority. All slugs must exist in WorkoutKit/Resources/exercises_seed.json.

exercises.pose: side view, body in straight plank, elbows bent 90 degrees, palms on the floor shoulder-width, lowering toward the ground
side view, full squat with thighs parallel to floor, knees tracking over toes, arms extended forward for balance, neutral spine
side view, bottom of squat with barbell across upper back, thighs parallel to floor, neutral spine
side view, lifting a barbell off the floor with hips back, neutral spine, arms straight, knees slightly bent
side view, hip hinge with slight knee bend, barbell traveling close to thighs, back flat, dumbbells or barbell mid-shin
side view, lying flat on bench, lowering a barbell to mid-chest, feet planted firmly
side view, lying flat on bench, dumbbells at chest level, elbows at ~45 degrees
three-quarter view, on a 30-45 degree incline bench, pressing two dumbbells over upper chest
front view, hanging from overhead bar with overhand grip wider than shoulders, pulling chin above the bar
front view, hanging from overhead bar with underhand grip shoulder-width, pulling chin above the bar
front view, seated at lat pulldown machine, pulling wide bar down to upper chest
side view, hip hinge with torso roughly 45 degrees, pulling barbell to lower ribcage, elbows tucked
side view, one knee and one hand on flat bench, free arm pulling a dumbbell to hip, flat back
side view, seated at cable row machine with knees slightly bent, pulling V-handle to lower ribcage, upright torso
front view, seated upright, pressing two dumbbells overhead from shoulder height, palms forward
front view, seated upright on bench with back support, pressing barbell overhead from clavicle height
front view, seated, dumbbells starting at shoulders palms-in then rotating to palms-forward as arms extend overhead
front view, standing, arms raising two dumbbells out to sides until parallel to floor, slight elbow bend
front view, standing at high cable, pulling rope attachment toward face, elbows high and wide
side view, suspended on parallel bars, elbows bent 90 degrees, torso slightly forward
side view, lying flat on bench, hands shoulder-width on barbell, elbows tucked close to ribs
front view, standing at high cable, elbows pinned to sides, pressing straight bar down to thighs
side view, lying flat on bench, lowering EZ-curl bar to forehead with elbows fixed pointing up
front view, standing, single dumbbell held overhead with both hands, lowering behind the head, elbows close together
front view, standing upright, curling barbell from thighs to shoulders, elbows pinned to sides
front view, standing upright, alternating curls with two dumbbells, palms supinating on the way up
front view, standing upright, curling two dumbbells with neutral grip (palms facing each other)
side view, seated at preacher bench with upper arms resting on the pad, curling EZ-bar toward face
side view, bottom of squat with barbell racked across front delts, elbows high, upright torso
side view, deep squat holding a single dumbbell vertically against chest, upright torso, elbows inside knees
side view, rear foot elevated on bench, front leg in deep lunge with thigh parallel, holding two dumbbells at sides
side view, mid-stride lunge with rear knee just above floor, front thigh parallel, holding two dumbbells at sides
side view, stepping onto a sturdy box with full foot, drive leg pushing through heel, holding two dumbbells
side view, upper back on bench, barbell across hips, hips fully extended, knees bent 90 degrees, glutes squeezed at top
exercises.equipment: flat bench, padded barbell across hips

exercises.pose: side view, lying supine on floor with knees bent, hips fully extended, glutes squeezed at top
side view, seated at leg extension machine, knees extending against pad until legs are nearly straight
side view, prone on leg curl machine, ankles curling pad toward glutes
side view, standing on a calf block with heels suspended, rising onto the balls of the feet
exercises.equipment: calf block or step, optional dumbbells

exercises.pose: side view, forearms and toes on floor, body in a perfectly straight line from heels to head
front view, supported on one forearm and one foot stack, hips lifted, body in a straight diagonal line
side view, supine with knees bent, shoulders curling off the floor, hands lightly behind head
three-quarter view, supine, opposite elbow to opposite knee with the other leg extended
side view, supine on floor, legs straight and lifting from floor toward vertical, lower back pressed flat
side view, hanging from pull-up bar, knees raised toward chest, controlled tempo
front view, seated with torso reclined and feet off floor, rotating a weight from side to side
exercises.equipment: single small plate or medicine ball

exercises.pose: side view, knees on mat, rolling ab wheel forward until torso is just above floor, neutral spine
side view, high plank position, one knee driving toward chest while the other leg stays extended
three-quarter view, mid-jump phase with arms extended overhead after rising from plank position
front view, mid-jump with legs spread wide and arms extended overhead
side view, hip-hinge swing with kettlebell at chest height, arms straight, knees soft
